integrity: All source-dependent formulas used in the proof were checked against the public preprint. The regular-variation and inverse-Gamma calculations were reconstructed independently from those formulas; no numerical experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns tail magnitude and positive moments of the cited UMVUEs; it does not compare decision-theoretic risk with other estimators.
The equal-index product-tail step is a standard regular-variation argument; novelty is claimed only for the exact Gamma-UMVUE application, constants, and phase boundary.
Literature searches found no covering statement, but an older equivalent result under different estimator-tail terminology remains possible.
title: Heavy-tail phase transition for the Gamma shape and rate UMVUEs
